projects.name: JyotishVeda – Vedic Kundali Analysis Platform
projects.overview: Designed and developed a full-featured Vedic astrology analysis platform that converts complex domain requirements into a user-friendly digital product — covering planetary positions, Drishti/aspects, Raj Yogas, D1–D12 divisional charts, Dasha, Remedies, and personalized Kundali insights — using AI-assisted product engineering throughout.
responsibilities: Designed a rules-driven astrology analysis architecture separating planetary calculations, Drishti logic, Yoga detection, divisional-chart calculations, and UI presentation.
Leveraged Generative AI and LLM-assisted workflows for architecture, reusable component design, domain rule implementation, debugging, and responsive UX.
Implemented personalized analysis workflows using user Kundali data to generate chart-specific insights across career, wealth, relationships, and planetary influences.
Developed a profile-based UX with persistent birth profiles, automatic location/coordinate resolution, profile switching, and multilingual English/Marathi support.
Applied AI-assisted iterative engineering to diagnose UI/data inconsistencies, preserve business logic, and progressively improve accessibility, design systems, and localization.
Took the product through a full lifecycle: requirements → design → development → validation → debugging → UI refinement → GitHub → Vercel deployment.
achievements: Delivered a production-ready Vedic astrology platform from a loosely defined business idea to a usable, deployed application.
Built a modular domain-driven architecture enabling new astrology capabilities to be added without rewriting core logic.
Demonstrated practical AI-assisted product engineering: requirement decomposition, domain-driven design, full-stack development, and rapid prototyping.
Implemented responsive experiences optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile with multilingual English/Marathi support.
Showcased the ability to use AI as a product engineering and problem-solving layer, not simply as a coding assistant.
